_comment: Why an approval call was refused, as a stable token.
The Problem Details `detail` is written in English and always will be, so a
UI that renders it answers a Korean reader in the wrong language on the one
screen where the reason decides what they do next. Two of these also share
a status code: refusing to decide your own request and lacking the grade are
both 403, and they ask the reader to do entirely different things.
Three places read this vocabulary: the backend map that stamps the token,
the frontend list that turns it into a translation key, and this file. A
token the backend sends and the frontend does not know renders the generic
fallback, which is the specific failure this file exists to prevent.
